name: Yuvomi
description: Yuvomi is a self-hosted family planner for tasks, calendar, meals, shopping, budget, and documents. It stores data in one SQLite database on your server.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Session secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Db encryption key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  yuvomi:
    image: ghcr.io/ulsklyc/yuvomi:2.73.0@sha256:86b874876612aa880bc5ce18563b2cd502e2230263aa3cc3a679d9d1245de938
    container_name: yuvomi
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/backups:/backups
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/modules:/app/modules
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/documents:/documents
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
      DB_PATH: /data/yuvomi.db
      BACKUP_DIR: /backups
      MODULES_DIR: /app/modules
      SESSION_SECRET: ${SECRET_SESSION_SECRET}
      DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SECRET_DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
      SESSION_SECURE: "false"
      TRUST_PROXY: loopback
      DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_ENABLED: "false"
      DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH: /documents
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', r => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1))"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
notes: Open host port 20004. New installs: replace SESSION_SECRET and DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY before starting Yuvomi; placeholders prevent startup. Generate a separate value for each with openssl rand -hex 32 and save the database key securely. To run unencrypted, clear DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Stores without pre-install variable editing require manual configuration before a successful start. CasaOS and ZimaOS use literal values, not Compose variable substitution. Existing installs: keep your current DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY when updating; replacing it prevents the database from opening. To migrate, download a backup under Settings > Backup, reinstall with a new key, then restore using the old key in the Backup key field. Optional weather, calendar, and OIDC settings are unset.
